issues.detail: Preparation of known aryl bromide 11 is delegated to cited literature; no commercial-to-11 route is invented.
Article Scheme 1 is retrosynthesis; Scheme 4 includes proposed epoxide 16 and unsuccessful experiments. Neither 16 nor speculative enolates are represented as obtained products.
The source draws unspecified epoxide stereochemistry and reports 2:1 dr. Both epoxide centers remain unspecified; no major/minor configuration is assigned.
9 is reported at 93:7 er; its SMILES identifies the named major enantiomer. For 15 the article distinguishes 3:1 crude dr from isolated major product. Purity is not inferred for downstream samples.
SI procedure says 0 C; SI scheme and article Scheme 5 say 20 C. No harmonized reaction temperature is asserted.
issues.subject: E10

issues.detail: SI procedure uses THF and aqueous NaOH, whereas the scheme and main text say MeOH/H2O. Structured solvent field follows the procedure and retains the conflict.
issues.subject: E11

issues.detail: SI gives 1.11 g and 3.19 mmol for iodide 12; these do not match its formula C15H23IO3 (about 378.25 g/mol). Source identity and HRMS support the iodine graph; amount data are not repaired.
Natural-product reference marker 4 in SI comparison headings is a literature citation, not the labels of Rhodocoranes D/E. Product labels are 5/6.

Telescoped preparations retain source-reported grouped yields. Only the explicitly drawn organolithium 13 is given an internal graph; unreported ester/alcohol/protected intermediates are not invented.
